title: Worker, dispatch and housekeeping follow-ups: the paid-session stub lifts only for an approved money gate and works on Windows, report and usage text read workers right, release commits its item file, the path setting stays in the clone, tidy and call-row order scale and sort right, forge reads keep their deadline and fields, the 7-Zip installer handles a folder with a space
goal: A refused money gate or an answer outside its options no longer lifts the paid-session stub, and on Windows the stub is a claude.cmd; report no longer warns of a gate not recorded for a line that says none was needed; the kbtools entry for backlog.py set names every option a batch refuses; release can commit its item file with --commit and says when it did not; the path setting type refuses a drive letter and backslash paths; tidy reads git status for a bounded number of worktrees; committed_calls keeps the newest call rows by their time; forge_reads ends at its deadline whatever runner it is given; ql_report.conflict_mrs reads its list by the forge the list was read from; the 7-Zip installer gets /D=PATH unquoted and last, so a folder with a space installs

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
